{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "A double-decker bus overturned on the A385 between Totnes and Paignton while traveling from Torquay to Plymouth at about 11:00 BST, leaving dozens injured."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "Police said up to eight people had been seriously hurt and were undergoing assessment."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "A total of 37 people are being treated at several hospitals around Devon, according to the NHS."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "The emergency services closed the road and a major incident was declared, which has now been stood down."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "Uninjured passengers were taken to Paignton bus station for support and help to continue their journeys."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "Jane Viner, chief nurse and deputy chief executive at Torbay and South Devon Foundation Trust, said many NHS staff had come in on their day off to help deal with the casualties and that it has been a huge team effort by emergency services and hospital staff."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "Gerald Taylor, the area manager for Devon & Somerset Fire and Rescue Service, said the road will stay shut in both directions for several hours for investigation and recovery."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "Police said the bus driver had not been arrested, confirming he was assisting them with their inquiries."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "A witness said there were emergency vehicles everywhere."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "A spokesman for Stagecoach South West said the company was helping emergency services and its thoughts were with the victims, and that safety is their priority and they will assist the investigation."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "Several ambulances and the air ambulance were sent to the scene."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "The Liberal Democrat MP for Totnes, Sarah Wollaston, thanked the emergency services for their efforts under difficult circumstances."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "Researchers have narrowed down how Pluto's giant ice blades form."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "The blades are made mostly of methane ice and form similarly to penitentes on Earth."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "New Horizons flew by Pluto in July 2015 and observed varied terrains."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "The jagged spikes form at the highest altitudes where methane freezes directly from gas to solid."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "When the climate warms, parts of the methane ice sublimate back to gas."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "Jeffrey Moore stated that climate variation causes the methane ice to evaporate."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "On Earth, such structures are called penitentes and are much shorter."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "Penitentes on Earth form due to sunlight concentrating on irregularities."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "Pluto's penitentes provide information about surface and air temperature changes over time."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "The link between methane and high elevations helps map Pluto's topography."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "The new work will appear in the journal Icarus."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "A report says climate change can be tackled if people embrace major lifestyle shifts."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "The authors compiled a list of top ways to reduce carbon footprint based on 7000 studies."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "The report calls for re-ordering government priorities to protect the planet."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "Living car-free is ranked first, saving 2.04 tonnes CO2 annually."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "Driving electric cars and taking fewer long-haul flights are also top actions."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "Switching to a vegan diet helps but less than transport; recycling is less effective."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "Lead author Dr Diana Ivanova argues for a change of mindset and carbon limits."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "She says the coronavirus lockdown shows many could live without cars."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "She says rich people consume most and aviation is under-taxed."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "Other top actions include renewable power, public transport, home insulation, heat pumps, and improved cookstoves."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "The study says implementing measures would save about nine tonnes CO2 per person per year."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "Experts note the study is valuable but only considers carbon footprint, not other impacts."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "Alicia Soto attended the 1 October Sunrise Remembrance Ceremony for the third consecutive year."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "Soto said attending the ceremony has helped her process her trauma from the Route 91 Harvest music festival mass shooting."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "Soto moved from California to Minneapolis and became a flight attendant, deciding to live life to the fullest for those who died."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "A slideshow displayed the names and pictures of the 58 people killed that night, plus the pictures of two women who died within the past year."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "Clark County Sheriff Joe Lombardo announced that Kimberly Gervais and Samanta Arjune will be added to the official death toll, raising it to 60."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "The announcement followed a Review-Journal article that reported the police department's initial decision not to include them."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "Lombardo said he is comfortable acknowledging that the two women lost their lives as a result of October 1."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "The ceremony had fewer attendees due to the coronavirus pandemic, forcing officials to limit attendance."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "Gov. Steve Sisolak said that raising the limit on public gatherings made Thursday's event one of his biggest priorities."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "Sisolak offered condolences to the families and said they will never forget what happened."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "Albert Rivera, father of victim Jordyn Rivera, thanked survivors for continuing to come together and support each other."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "Rivera acknowledged Greg Zanis, who built crosses for the victims and died in May of terminal bladder cancer."},
    {"id": "12", "subevent": "Rivera called for unity, urging people to remember how they came together on October 2, 2017."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "President Joko Widodo requested that the revision process of the Coal and Mineral Mining Law be suspended."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "Incoming legislators began discussing the revisions despite Jokowi's request."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "A working committee of House members and the government resumed deliberations on the revisions."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "Students demanded outright rejection of the revisions and led mass protests across Indonesia."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "On September 25, Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources officials submitted an unfinished list of 938 concerns to initiate deliberation."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "The DPR abandoned its plans to push through the revisions after public pressure and the president's call."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "The working committee convened and agreed on 235 of 703 proposed changes."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "The draft under discussion remained unchanged from the previous year."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "The proposed revisions would allow companies to extend permits without offering concessions to state-owned companies and remove prison terms for corrupt officials."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "The revisions would remove companies' responsibility for rehabilitating mining sites, including filling pits, and add fines and prison terms for hindering mining activities."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "The revisions removed communities' right to veto mining activities."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "In December 2020, a 110-million-year-old dinosaur named Ubirajara jubatus was described with unique features including furlike filaments and spearlike feathers."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "The fossil sparked a legal and ethical controversy between German paleontologists and officials, who claim the fossil, and the Brazilian scientific community, which wants it back."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "The journal Cretaceous Research retracted the paper describing Ubirajara jubatus."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "Brazilian paleontologists questioned the legality of the fossil's export, citing a 1942 Brazilian law that requires permits for collecting fossils and a 1990 decree requiring export approval."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "The original paper stated that the fossil was brought to Germany in 1995 with an export permit signed by a Brazilian official."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "A German ministry spokesperson said the fossil was actually imported in 2006 by a private company and acquired by the State Museum of Natural History Karlsruhe in 2009."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "Social media campaign #UbirajaraBelongstoBR accused the authors and museum of illegally taking the fossil."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "The journal temporarily withdrew the paper on December 24, 2020, while the controversy played out."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "The Baden-Württemberg ministry backed the museum's ownership claim, stating the fossil was legally acquired under German law."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "The Brazilian paleontology community expressed outrage at the ministry's ownership claim."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "Cretaceous Research permanently withdrew the paper, citing unresolved concerns about specimen export."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "The journal updated its policy on fossil provenance, stating it will not accept papers about specimens suspected to be illegally collected or exported."},
    {"id": "12", "subevent": "The permanent withdrawal rekindled Brazilian demands for repatriation, and the German ministry said it will reexamine the processes and explore an agreeable solution."},
    {"id": "13", "subevent": "A preprint analysis found that Germany, the UK, and France contributed more than 10% of paleontology papers but most research used fossils from abroad, often without local authors."},
    {"id": "14", "subevent": "Some paleontologists argued fossils are safer in European or US institutions, while Brazilian scientists countered that disasters can happen anywhere."},
    {"id": "15", "subevent": "The controversy prompted voluntary repatriation of a spider fossil and 35 other specimens from the University of Kansas Natural History Museum to Brazil."},
    {"id": "16", "subevent": "The retraction left the species Ubirajara jubatus nonexistent to science, as described by paleontologist Felipe Pinheiro."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "Ukraine's government and pro-Russia rebels agreed a memorandum on a peace plan for the eastern conflict."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "The nine-point deal includes setting up a 30km buffer zone, a ban on overflights of part of eastern Ukraine by military aircraft, and the withdrawal of foreign mercenaries on both sides."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "The agreement was announced at talks in the Belarusian capital Minsk."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "More than 3,000 have died in fighting in two eastern regions since April."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "The original ceasefire agreed on 5 September has been frequently violated but is still holding."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "Ukraine accuses Russia of arming separatists and sending Russian troops to the eastern Donetsk and Luhansk regions."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "The Kremlin denies it has any role there."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "Three powerful blasts rocked the main rebel-held city of Donetsk, with eyewitnesses saying that a chemical plant may have been hit."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "A humanitarian convoy of about 200 lorries from Russia arrived in Donetsk."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "Russia says the convoy delivered food, water, and generators, but this was done without Ukraine's authorisation."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "The deal was reached after late-night talks between representatives of Ukraine, Russia, eastern separatists and the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE)."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "Former Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma, representing Kiev at the talks, said that all sides had agreed to move back some of their heavy weapons."},
    {"id": "12", "subevent": "Kuchma said heavy artillery will be moved 15km away from the front line."},
    {"id": "13", "subevent": "Kuchma added that the deal would be implemented within 24 hours and monitors from the OSCE would travel to the buffer zone to check for compliance."},
    {"id": "14", "subevent": "Separatist leader Alexander Zakharchenko said that the two sides did not discuss the status of the rebel-held areas of Luhansk and Donetsk."},
    {"id": "15", "subevent": "Earlier this week, Ukraine's parliament passed a bill granting a three-year self-rule to parts of the Donetsk and Luhansk regions."},
    {"id": "16", "subevent": "The Russian ambassador to Ukraine, Mikhail Zurabov, said that mercenaries were fighting on both sides and called on OSCE to oversee their removal."},
    {"id": "17", "subevent": "Russia has repeatedly said that any of its citizens fighting alongside separatists in Ukraine are doing so in a private capacity."},
    {"id": "18", "subevent": "There are now fears in Ukraine that Russia wants to create a frozen conflict in eastern Ukraine."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "Washington becomes the first US state to legalize human composting."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "Governor Jay Inslee signs the bill into law on Tuesday."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "Katrina Spade, who lobbied for the law, founded a company called Recompose that could be the first to provide the service."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "Spade says recomposition offers an alternative to embalming and burial or cremation that is natural, safe, and sustainable, with significant savings in carbon emissions and land usage."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "The process involves placing a body in a hexagonal steel container filled with alfalfa, wood chips, and straw."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "The container is shut and the body decomposes naturally within 30 days, creating two wheelbarrows' worth of soil."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "Loved ones are given the soil, which they can use in planting flowers, vegetables, or trees."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "Environmentally friendly burial alternatives are becoming increasingly popular."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "Late actor Luke Perry was laid to rest in a 'mushroom suit' in California."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "The suit's creator says it reduces toxic pollutants released during decomposition and cremation."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "A hacking group linked to Iran attempted to break into President Trump’s re-election campaign but was unsuccessful."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "Microsoft reported significant cyber activity by the group targeting current and former U.S. officials, journalists, and prominent Iranians."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "Trump campaign director Tim Murtaugh said the campaign had no indication its infrastructure was targeted."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "Over a 30-day period, the group made more than 2,700 attempts to identify consumer email accounts and attacked 241, compromising four accounts not associated with the campaign."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "Microsoft did not identify the targeted election campaign; 19 Democrats and three Republicans are running."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "Hacking to interfere in elections has been a concern since Russia’s 2016 operation."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "Tensions between the U.S. and Iran have risen since Trump withdrew from the nuclear accord and reinstated sanctions."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "Iran did not immediately comment on Microsoft’s statement."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "The group Phosphorous used information gathering to game password reset features and attempted to take over accounts; attacks were not technically sophisticated."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "Microsoft has tracked Phosphorous since 2013 and took control of 99 websites the group used in March."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "The 2016 Clinton campaign was hacked in a cyberattack on Democratic Party organizations."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "Big tech companies met with U.S. intelligence agencies in September to discuss security strategies."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "Two police officers, Pierluigi Rotta and Matteo Demenego, were killed in a shooting at the police station in Trieste."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "The shooter, Alejandro Augusto Stephan Meran, a 29-year-old from the Dominican Republic described as mentally disturbed, had been brought to the station with his brother after a scooter robbery."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "Alejandro Meran distracted the agents and shot them at close range."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "Both brothers attempted to flee but were stopped."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "Earlier that morning, Alejandro Meran had stolen a scooter from a woman, causing her to fall, then felt remorse and called his brother for advice."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "The brother alerted the police, but once at the station, Alejandro asked to go to the bathroom and suddenly took two guns from the officers and killed them."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "After shooting the first officer, Meran encountered and shot a second officer, then took his pistol."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "Meran had a third exchange of fire with an officer at the guard post, who wounded him."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "Meran exited the building but was blocked by the mobile squad, then chased and wounded in the groin."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "The brother Carlysle Stephan Meran hid in the basement and did not participate in the shooting."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "Witnesses reported multiple gunshots causing panic, and the area was cordoned off with security."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "President Sergio Mattarella sent a message of condolence, and the mayor of Trieste declared city mourning."},
    {"id": "12", "subevent": "The Interior Minister and police chief traveled to Trieste, and a spontaneous candlelight march was planned for the next evening."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "South Africa and India renewed their bid to waive rules of the WTO’s TRIPS agreement."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "South Africa argued the current TRIPS system does not work, pointing to the failure during the HIV/AIDS pandemic."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "Medecins Sans Frontieres put together a letter signed by over 375 civil society organisations supporting the waiver."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "The proposal was backed by dozens of developing countries but opposed by Western countries with large pharmaceutical industries."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "India is a major manufacturer of generics."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "Western nations argued that protecting intellectual property rights encouraged research and innovation and suspending rights would not result in a sudden surge of vaccine supply."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "The WTO’s TRIPS Council spent three hours debating but failed to agree."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "They agreed to discuss the matter twice again in April before the next scheduled TRIPS Council meeting on June 8-9."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala became WTO director-general on March 1."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "Okonjo-Iweala called the intensifying TRIPS discussions 'vitally important' but said governments and businesses needed to act now to increase production."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "She said manufacturers should come together with bodies such as the WHO and GAVI and business associations to look into options."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "She said they must deliver concrete solutions for the millions of people waiting."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon rose more than 50% in the first three months of 2020 compared to the same period last year, according to preliminary satellite data."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "Scientists warned that Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro's development-friendly policies could transform the Amazon past a tipping point into a drier savannah-like landscape."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "Brazil's environmental agency scaled back enforcement measures since the COVID-19 outbreak, leaving indigenous tribes more vulnerable to threats."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "Laercio Guajajara stated that their territory keeps being invaded by loggers and hunters, even during the pandemic."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "Andre Karipuna expressed desperation, saying just one infected person could rapidly pass the virus to the whole tribe."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "Brazil's indigenous tribes have been under increased pressure since Bolsonaro took office in 2019, as he slashed funding and enforcement at FUNAI."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "In July 2019, Bolsonaro appointed a federal police officer with agribusiness connections to head FUNAI."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "Last summer, ABC News embedded with the Guajajara tribe's 'Guardians' during a patrol, resulting in the documentary 'Guardians of the Amazon'."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "In April 2020, FUNAI passed controversial law IN 09, preventing long-held indigenous lands awaiting demarcation from being labelled as indigenous in the land registry."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "Environmental groups allege that IN 09 provides a route for illegal occupiers to claim land is not indigenous, affecting nearly one third of indigenous lands."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "Provisional Measure (MP) 910, decreed by Bolsonaro in December 2019, is being considered for permanent law, allowing those who illegally deforested and occupied federal lands before December 2018 to purchase at reduced prices."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "Critics allege MP 910 rewards illegal land grabbers, and an IMAZON analysis found it could lead to deforestation of up to 16,000 square kilometers by 2027."},
    {"id": "12", "subevent": "The Bolsonaro administration denies that the new land ownership rules would facilitate land-grabbing, arguing new landowners must preserve up to 80% of their land and only those who occupied peacefully for many years get titles."},
    {"id": "13", "subevent": "Since enforcement rollbacks, reports of illegal logging and violent attacks across indigenous reserves have increased."},
    {"id": "14", "subevent": "In early April, Yanomami leaders reported an increase in illegal gold mining during the pandemic, and BBC Brasil published satellite photos showing illegal miners moving into an area with an isolated community."},
    {"id": "15", "subevent": "Some leaders blamed invasions for the April 10th death of a 15-year-old boy who was the first Yanomami known to die from the virus."},
    {"id": "16", "subevent": "The Karipuna tribe submitted a complaint on April 8th stating non-indigenous people were clearing inside their reserve, demanding authorities take measures."},
    {"id": "17", "subevent": "On April 18th, a 33-year-old indigenous leader of the Uru-eu-wau-wau reserve was reportedly assassinated for his criticism of illegal logging."},
    {"id": "18", "subevent": "In March, Zezico Rodrigues Guajajara was killed by a shotgun-wielding assailant, becoming the fifth Guajajara murdered in as many months."},
    {"id": "19", "subevent": "Erival Guajajara expressed fear for their lives due to vulnerability."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "Fifty-two people died on Sunday at a religious festival in Ethiopia to celebrate the end of the rainy season after police fired tear gas at protesters triggering a stampede."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "Violence broke out at the gathering in the town of Bishoftu near the capital Addis Ababa due to the actions of 'irresponsible forces', the regional government said in a statement, adding that 'as a consequence, 52 people died in this crush.'"},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "Opposition groups said they believed more than 100 people had been killed in the chaos after thousands of people gathered at a sacred lake for the Irreecha ceremony."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "Some festival participants crossed their wrists above their heads, a gesture that has become a symbol of protest by the Oromo community."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "A government statement published by state media said 'the annual Irreecha festival has been disrupted due to a violence created by some groups... Loss of lives has occurred due to a stampede.'"},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "Merera Gudina, chairman of the opposition Oromo Federalist Congress, told AFP there had been many fatalities and said 'Bodies are being collected by the government. But what I hear from people on the ground is that the number of dead is more than one hundred.'"},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "Sunday's event quickly degenerated into violence, with protesters throwing stones and bottles and security forces responding with baton charges and tear gas grenades, with some reports of gunfire."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "The police action sent people fleeing in panic with many falling on top of each other into a ditch."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "Police demanded that AFP's photographer leave the scene, where rubber bullets were seen strewn on the ground."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "Oromo activists called for 'five days of rage' to protest the deaths while a strong police presence was visible as the news of the day's events spread."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "Mohamed Jafar said 'This government is a dictatorship, there is no equality or freedom of speech. There is only TPLF. That's why we must protest today,' referring to the Tigrayan People's Liberation Front."},
    {"id": "11", "subevent": "In 1991 the TPLF, then a rebel group, overthrew Mengistu Haile Mariam's dictatorship and now, as a political party, stands accused of monopolising power."},
    {"id": "12", "subevent": "Every year millions of people in the Oromo region mark the Irreecha festival on the shores of Lake Harsadi, which they consider sacred."},
    {"id": "13", "subevent": "The anti-government protests started in the central and western Oromo region in 2015 and spread in recent months to the northern Amhara region."},
    {"id": "14", "subevent": "Habte Bulcha said 'For the last 25 years the Oromo people have been marginalised in many things. Today we come together as one to chant for our freedom.'"},
    {"id": "15", "subevent": "Together, Oromos and Amharas make up 60 percent of the population of the Horn of Africa nation and have become increasingly vocal in rejecting what they see as the disproportionate power wielded by the northern Tigrean minority in government and the security forces."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "UNESCO re-elected Audrey Azoulay as director-general for a second mandate."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "Azoulay hailed a new confidence and unity in the organization."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "UNESCO had been riven by divisions when Azoulay took office in 2017 with both Israel and the United States exiting the agency over accusations of anti-Israeli bias."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "Azoulay won her new mandate at UNESCO’s general conference with 155 votes in favor, nine against, and one abstention."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "Azoulay said the result is a sign of regained unity and that they have been able to restore confidence in UNESCO."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "Azoulay added that they regained serenity by reducing political tensions and looking for common positions on divisive subjects."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "UNESCO has been at the forefront of high-profile projects such as rebuilding the old city of Mosul in Iraq and schools in Beirut damaged by the August 2020 blast."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "Azoulay’s greatest challenge for her second four-year term will be seeking to woo Israel and the US back into the organization."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "A source close to Azoulay told AFP in the run-up to the conference that there were positive signs that Israel and the US could be considering a return."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "For some, the return of the US would be a welcome balance to the growing importance and influence of China, which now makes up over 15 percent of the total compulsory budget contributions."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
    {"id": "0", "subevent": "The High Court observed that journalists digging out information and publishing it does not constitute an offence."},
    {"id": "1", "subevent": "The observation was made by a High Court bench of Justice Md Habibul Gani and Justice Md Riaz Uddin Khan."},
    {"id": "2", "subevent": "The bench made the observation while hearing a bail petition filed by Moazzem Hossain."},
    {"id": "3", "subevent": "Moazzem's lawyer argued that his client did not circulate the video clip; a journalist had collected it from Moazzem's phone and spread it."},
    {"id": "4", "subevent": "After hearing the arguments, the HC bench made the observation about journalists."},
    {"id": "5", "subevent": "The bench refused to grant bail to Moazzem because there is a specific allegation that he recorded and circulated Nusrat's statement without her permission."},
    {"id": "6", "subevent": "The court kept the bail petition stand over for the next three months, according to Deputy Attorney General Md Rezaul Karim."},
    {"id": "7", "subevent": "Moazzem sought bail from the High Court on the ground that he has been in jail since June 16, 2019."},
    {"id": "8", "subevent": "On November 29, 2019, a Dhaka court sentenced Moazzem to eight years' rigorous imprisonment for the offence."},
    {"id": "9", "subevent": "Nusrat Jahan Rafi was set on fire on April 6, 2019 allegedly for refusing to withdraw a sexual assault case against the madrasa principal."},
    {"id": "10", "subevent": "She died five days later at Dhaka Medical College Hospital."}
  ]
}

{
  "subevents": [
